title: Kingstown pier, Stephen said. Yes, a disappointed bridge
html_source:
Stephen diverts the attention of the ‘mirthless but with meaning’ brigade changing from an authoritative power (he knew the correct answer) to a sympathetic figure even if they didn’t get his joke (a disappointed bridge is a type of bridge). Stephen has sacrificed his position in the eyes of those who are laughing at Armstrong to protect Armstrong.

GavanKennedy :
The end of the both piers frame Howth Head across Dublin Bay, where Molly finally affirms her love of Leopold.
